extraction.Name: Mary Rice (Long)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to Pawnee Nat. Bank for $1500 due Jan. 1, 1929.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: The allottee still owns the land and is keeping up the taxes.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Land rented for $400 per year. Income from inherited land approximately $160 per year. Receives pension from deceased husband of about $40.00 per month.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered Dec. 26, 1917 by mail. No foreclosure; date of redemption not expired. Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes: no. No property or funds accumulated. No persons dependent upon the Indian for support. The allottee feels that the Government made a mistake in issuing her a patent to the land. Document notarized November 28, 1928, in Pawnee County, State of Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929.
